svg.text: Shifted test sets against the number of distinct practice maps
S6 (slope of Y_tempo on k, replicate fixed effects):
Distinct practice maps per run, N (log scale)
ln(failures per object), lower is better
S7 (slope of Y_pattern on k, replicate fixed effects):
Distinct practice maps per run, N (log scale)
Hollow: replicate runs (jittered); filled: arm mean; bars: 95% CI of the mean; faint blue: T_ID arm means for comparison. Both panels share the y-axis. Complete replicate sets: r1, r2, r3.
